item.tib: dbal phur bsnyen sgrab las gsum stong 'dzab kyi 'grel pa
item.coloph: de ltar dbal phur nag po'i bsnyen bsgrub las gsum stong 'dzab kyi 'grel ba zur tsam bstan pa/ kho bo stag la'i thugs sprul dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal stag slag can bdag gis dben gnas maDul ri khrod 'ur 'ur 'bar zhes gsang mchog lcang lo'i tshal du spel ba'o// bkra shis par shog/
